newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet firms with IPE, barge premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet firms with IPE, barge premiums steady.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices firmed slightly in line with IPE futures on Thursday, traders said.
November gas oil IPE futures closed 25 cents up at $227.75 a tonne.

On the Rotterdam market, prompt barges were sold at Nov IPE +$32.25, +$33.25 and +$30.50 fob ARA, steady on Wednesday's levels. Cargo offers were talked around Nov IPE +$26/28 cif NWE and traders said demand was steady. He noted cargoes unusually were cheaper than barges at present, which was not sustainable in the longer term. -- William Maclean, London newsroom +44 171 542 7646
